claim: A pending-reboot parameter group status does not cause an automatic reboot in the next maintenance window; you must reboot the DB instance manually to apply the changes.
question: Will RDS reboot the instance in the maintenance window to apply pending parameter changes?

values.display: doesn't result in an automatic reboot

evidence.quote: This status doesn't result in an automatic reboot during the next maintenance window. To apply the latest parameter changes to that DB instance, manually reboot the DB instance.

claim: Changing the maintenance window does not prevent mandatory upgrades: after the mandatory apply date, RDS can apply a forced upgrade outside the preferred maintenance window.
question: Can you avoid a mandatory RDS engine upgrade by moving the maintenance window?

values.display: outside of your preferred maintenance window
after the mandatory apply date has passed

evidence.quote: If you repeatedly modify your DB instance maintenance window to avoid a pending mandatory upgrade, Amazon RDS can still apply the upgrade outside of your preferred maintenance window after the mandatory apply date has passed.
